exact_statement: For every Boolean seed g on n>=1 uniform bits and k>=2 fresh bits, N=n+k, let F(x,z)=g(x)(-1)^{1[wt(x,z)<=1]}. Put D0=sum_i 1[g(0)!=g(e_i)] and D1=sum_{i!=j} 1[g(e_j)!=g(e_i+e_j)]. Then I(F)=I(g)+2^{1-N}[N(N-1)-2kD0-2D1]. Any deterministic finite r-bit summary E(z) from which the entire fresh-block residual row is decodable satisfies sum_j I(E_j)>=k^2*2^{1-k}; no such summary exists for r=1 and equality is attainable for every r>=2. For g=-1 only at 00, I(F_k)=1+(k^2-k+2)*2^{-k-1}, H(F_k)>1 for every k>=32, and H(F_k)->2. Hence H(F_k)/(inf_E sum_j I(E_j)) tends to infinity but H(F_k)/I(F_k)->2. This refutes only universal payment of total entropy from fresh-summary influence alone, not FEI.
